author: traditional
body:
Hello, I'm Traditional and I was recently (approximately 20 minutes ago) banned for the use of hacked clients which I admit of using, Reasoning why I hacked on your server was because of the stupid reason that I was bored, had nothing to do. So I though about the stupid idea to hack on different kind of servers which sadly Avicus popped up on the list of interesting servers to hack on, the reason why I want to be unbanned from Avicus is because while I was hacking I felt that the community was mature, calm and didn't say stuff like "F*** you", "Kill yourself" etc. When I first got banned on the account "Exclusive" I really didn't care (I admit I was ban evading yes...). But the staff member(s) who banned me did it really professional. I would like to be unbanned so I could get a second chance to (without hacking) start playing this enjoyable community as a new player. I know I did ruin the players gameplay experience when I was hacking which is not very fun for a server with such an enjoyable gamemode like DTM, I'm really sorry for hacking on Avicus and I'd hope to be unbanned and be able to play like a normal player.

Thanks for reading, and once again. Sorry for hacking on your server.

- Traditional (#SkidSquad member)

title: traditional's ban appeal.

replies.author: _Nathy
replies.body:
Hi traditional,

"Ban evasion is not permitted and will result in a permanent ban on all accounts associated with the original Minecraft account."

Unfortunately since you have ban evaded on several accounts, you will not be unbanned.

This appeal is denied.
